lesson_fields.title: Redox Reactions
lesson_fields.summary: Redox reactions are where oxidation and reduction happen together. Oxidation is the loss of electrons, reduction is the gain of electrons. We can spot them by electron loss or gain.
lesson_fields.summary_fr: Les reactions d'oxydoreduction sont celles ou l'oxydation et la reduction ont lieu ensemble. L'oxydation est la perte d'electrons, la reduction est le gain d'electrons. On les reconnait a la perte ou au gain d'electrons.
lesson_fields.content:
## Oxidation and reduction

Oxidation means loss of electrons. Reduction means gain of electrons. They always happen together, so we call them redox reactions.

## Simple examples

In a reaction between magnesium and oxygen, magnesium loses electrons and is oxidised. Oxygen gains electrons and is reduced.
lesson_fields.content_fr:
## Oxydation et reduction

L'oxydation est la perte d'electrons. La reduction est le gain d'electrons. Elles ont toujours lieu ensemble, c'est pourquoi on les appelle des reactions d'oxydoreduction.

## Exemples simples

Dans la reaction entre le magnesium et l'oxygene, le magnesium perd des electrons et est oxyde. L'oxygene gagne des electrons et est reduit.
objectives: Explain oxidation and reduction in terms of electrons
Recognise which substance is oxidised and which is reduced
Write a simple redox example with electrons
objectives_fr: Expliquer l'oxydation et la reduction en termes d'electrons
Reconnaitre la substance oxydee et la substance reduite

steps.title: OIL and RIG
steps.content:
A handy way to remember is OIL RIG.

Oxidation Is Loss of electrons. Reduction Is Gain of electrons.

Oxidation and reduction always happen together, so every redox reaction has both.
steps.content_fr:
Un moyen facile de s'en souvenir est OIL RIG.

Oxydation Is Loss (perte) d'electrons. Reduction Is Gain (gain) d'electrons.

L'oxydation et la reduction ont toujours lieu ensemble, donc chaque reaction d'oxydoreduction comprend les deux.

question.text: What does OIL stand for in redox?
question.explanation_fr: Oxydation Is Loss : l'oxydation est la perte d'electrons.

steps.title: Reduction is gain
steps.content:
RIG means Reduction Is Gain of electrons. The species that gains electrons becomes more negative or less positive.

Since electrons are negative, gaining them gives a reduction in the positive charge.
steps.content_fr:
RIG signifie Reduction Is Gain : la reduction est le gain d'electrons. La particule qui gagne des electrons devient plus negative ou moins positive.

Comme les electrons sont negatifs, en en gagnant la charge positive diminue.

steps.title: Worked example: magnesium and oxygen
steps.content:
Magnesium burns in oxygen to give magnesium oxide, MgO.

Magnesium atoms lose two electrons: Mg becomes Mg^2+. This is oxidation.

Oxygen atoms gain two electrons: O becomes O^2-. This is reduction.

Both happen together, so it is a redox reaction.
steps.content_fr:
Le magnesium brûle dans l'oxygene et donne l'oxyde de magnesium, MgO.

Les atomes de magnesium perdent deux electrons : Mg devient Mg^2+. C'est l'oxydation.

Les atomes d'oxygene gagnent deux electrons : O devient O^2-. C'est la reduction.

Les deux se produisent ensemble, c'est donc une reaction d'oxydoreduction.

steps.title: Your turn: copper and oxygen
steps.content: When copper reacts with oxygen, copper loses two electrons to become Cu^2+. Decide whether copper is oxidised or reduced.
steps.content_fr: Quand le cuivre reagit avec l'oxygene, le cuivre perd deux electrons et devient Cu^2+. Determine s'il est oxyde ou reduit.

question.text: Copper loses two electrons. What happens to it?
question.text_fr: Le cuivre perd deux electrons. Que lui arrive-t-il ?
question.explanation: Loss of electrons is oxidation, so copper is oxidised.
question.explanation_fr: La perte d'electrons est l'oxydation, donc le cuivre est oxyde.
question.hint_prompt_fr: Applique OIL : la perte signifie oxydation.

steps.title: Check: electron gain
steps.content: If a species gains electrons, the positive charge on it goes down. For example, a copper ion Cu^2+ gaining two electrons becomes copper metal, Cu.
steps.content_fr: Si une particule gagne des electrons, sa charge positive diminue. Par exemple, un ion cuivre Cu^2+ qui gagne deux electrons devient du cuivre metallique, Cu.

question.text: A copper ion Cu^2+ gains two electrons. What is it?
question.text_fr: Un ion cuivre Cu^2+ gagne deux electrons. Que devient-il ?
question.explanation: Gaining electrons is reduction, and Cu^2+ plus two electrons gives Cu.
question.explanation_fr: Gagner des electrons est la reduction, et Cu^2+ plus deux electrons donne Cu.
question.hint_prompt: Gain means reduction; the charge becomes zero.
question.hint_prompt_fr: Gain signifie reduction ; la charge devient nulle.

hints.text: Reduction produces the element in its metallic form here.
hints.text_fr: La reduction donne ici l'element sous forme metallique.

steps.title: What to keep
steps.content: Oxidation is loss of electrons, reduction is gain of electrons. They happen together in redox reactions. OIL RIG helps you to remember which is which.
steps.content_fr: L'oxydation est la perte d'electrons, la reduction est le gain d'electrons. Elles ont lieu ensemble dans les reactions d'oxydoreduction. Le moyen mnemonique OIL RIG aide a les retenir.

questions.explanation_fr: Reduction Is Gain : la reduction est le gain d'electrons.
questions.hint_prompt_fr: La reduction concerne le gain d'electrons.

choices.text_fr: La reduction est le gain d'electrons

hints.text: The second part of OIL RIG is RIG.
hints.text_fr: La deuxieme partie de OIL RIG est RIG.

questions.explanation_fr: L'oxydation et la reduction ont lieu ensemble.

questions.hint_prompt_fr: On ne peut pas avoir l'une sans l'autre.

choices.text_fr: Oxydation et reduction ont toutes deux lieu

questions.text: Magnesium loses electrons. What is this called?
questions.text_fr: Le magnesium perd des electrons. Comment appelle-t-on cela ?

questions.text: Oxygen gains electrons. What is this called?
questions.text_fr: L'oxygene gagne des electrons. Comment appelle-t-on cela ?
questions.explanation_fr: Le gain d'electrons est la reduction.

questions.text: In the reaction Mg plus O2 to MgO, which is oxidised?
questions.text_fr: Dans la reaction Mg plus O2 donnant MgO, lequel est oxyde ?
questions.explanation: Magnesium loses electrons, so it is oxidised.
questions.explanation_fr: Le magnesium perd des electrons, il est donc oxyde.
